title: 律师

series.next: 深圳, 2004. The new flat looks over a city being built, and there's a note on the table: 别问。

setting: 舅舅's boat workshop on the 珠江 delta, 2004. You're eighteen, with tar on your hands. A black car stops outside.

jiujiu.name: 舅舅
jiujiu.en: your uncle: quiet, awkward, on your side

jia.name: 贾律师
jia.en: a lawyer from 深圳: precise, and cold

steps.narr: Six years of Saturdays at the villa on the hill. You win at chess now, sometimes. 小雪 still won't look at you.

else.narr: You never went back to the villa. Last spring 何小姐 sent for you anyway, and you played chess in silence.

steps.narr: 2004. 舅舅's boat workshop. Tar, sawdust, and the radio on low.
A black car stops outside. A lawyer in a grey suit steps over the nets without touching them.

steps.en: My name is 贾. A lawyer, from 深圳.

steps.zh: 有人愿意出钱，让你去深圳读书，过另一种生活。
steps.en: Someone is willing to pay for you to study in 深圳, and live a different life.

steps.zh: 条件只有一个：永远不要问，是谁。
steps.en: There is one condition. You never ask who.

say.tip: 出钱 chū qián = put up the money. 是谁出的钱？ = who is it that's paying?

ok.zh: 第一个问题，就违反了条件。
ok.en: Your very first question breaks the condition.

answers: 贾律师，请问到底是谁出的钱？
4.gloss: 贾律师, who exactly is paying?

steps.zh: 再问一次，一切取消。你听清楚了吗？
steps.en: Ask again, and it's all off. Is that clear?

say.en: Agree to the condition: you won't ask.
say.tip: 我不问 = I won't ask. 听清楚了 = heard you clearly.

ok.zh: 很好。下个月一号，去深圳。
ok.en: Good. On the first of next month, you go to 深圳.

ok.zh: 钱每个月会到。不够，找我。
ok.en: Money will arrive every month. If it isn't enough, come to me.

answers: 听清楚了，我保证，我不问。
4.gloss: Clear. I promise I won't ask.

steps.en: ...Will you have a cup of tea, 贾律师?

steps.narr: You're sure you know who it is. There's only one rich person you've ever met. Ask, without asking.

say.en: Ask after 何小姐: is she well?
answers: 贾律师，何小姐最近好吗？
say.gloss: Is 何小姐 well these days?
say.tip: 最近 zuìjìn = lately. ……好吗？ asks after someone.

ok.en: ...何小姐 is also a client of mine.

ok.zh: 她让我告诉你：小雪下个月出国。
ok.en: She asked me to tell you: 小雪 goes abroad next month.

answers: 我不问是谁。何小姐最近还好吗？
4.gloss: I won't ask who. Is 何小姐 keeping well?

steps.narr: The car goes. 舅舅 stands in the doorway, wiping his hands on a rag that's dirtier than they are.

steps.en: 深圳... that's good. That's good.
I'm no good with words. Don't laugh at me.
You were always the clever one. Cleverer than me.

say.en: Tell 舅舅 you'll come back.
say.tip: 会……的 = will, for certain: 我会回来的.

ok.narr: 舅舅 wipes his hands on his apron, twice, and hugs you: badly, and very hard.

answers: 舅舅，不管去哪儿，我都会回来的。
4.gloss: 舅舅, wherever I go, I'll come back.

steps.zh: 律师说下个月？你怎么想？
steps.en: The lawyer said next month? What do you think?

say.en: Go to 深圳 at once, or ask for a day to think.
say.tip: 去深圳 = go to 深圳: said plainly, it's a decision.

alts.en: Or: ask for a day to think
alts.gloss: Let me think for a day.

then.zh: 想吧。今晚我做你爱吃的。
then.en: Think, then. Tonight I'll make your favourite.

alts.gloss: Let me think for a day.

answers: 我决定了，下个月就去深圳。
4.gloss: I've decided. I'm going to 深圳 next month.

answers: 这么大的事，让我想一天。
alts.gloss: It's a big thing. Let me think for a day.

steps.en: The first of the month. A bus north, a bag 舅妈 packed twice, and 舅舅 waving long after you can see him. 🚌

else.en: One night on the jetty, thinking. In the morning you pack anyway, and 舅舅 pretends not to cry. 🚌
